items.text: The Eagles will play their first game on Sunday without Jalen Hurts.
items.why: Superficial blood clot in calf; Tanner McKee starts
items.implication: First career miss of this type; pocket passer McKee + thin RB room elevates healthy pass-catchers but caps ceiling
items.opportunity: DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks, Lemon as top-4 healthy; McKee volume

items.text: ETR Sunday injury roundup lists Saquon Barkley OUT for Week 6 vs CAR (with Will Shipley also OUT).
items.why: Hamstring; confirmed in ETR final roundup and Schefter ruling
items.implication: PHI RB room reduced to Dameon Pierce/Carson Steele types; pass-catchers become primary fantasy path with McKee
items.opportunity: Goal-line/early-down vacuum for remaining PHI RBs; elevated target share for DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks

items.text: Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson for Sunday’s game at Cleveland due to his ankle injury.
items.implication: Second straight miss; Tyler Huntley starts again; downgrade to Ravens pass catchers especially Andrews
items.opportunity: Huntley game script may still support Flowers as WR2

items.text: AJ Brown practiced all week on a limited basis (earlier than expected) and is questionable; Patriots Friday report confirms Q.
items.why: Limited practice all week post high-ankle context
items.implication: Possible return but unclear per Levitan; monitor final inactive
items.opportunity: If OUT, NE WR/RB hierarchy shifts (Henderson also Q)
items.conflict: Levitan still unclear on true status

items.text: Levitan on ETR report: Unclear on AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren (groin) Friday Q add. Caleb/Metcalf/Olave/Dowdle Q tags look more probable. PIT thin at WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) → expect heavy 2-WR Metcalf + Bernard. PHI McKee has 4th-string RB but healthy top-4 pass-catchers (DeVonta, Goedert, Wicks, Lemon).
items.why: Practice/report reading + Friday adds; PIT depth chart observation
items.implication: Brown/Henderson true game-time risk; Warren new concern for IND TE; Metcalf/Olave/Caleb/Dowdle startable if active; PHI WRs/TE safer than RBs with McKee
items.opportunity: PIT 2-WR concentration to Metcalf; PHI pass-catcher volume with thin RB

items.text: ETR lists Breece Hall OUT (with AD Mitchell).
items.implication: Braelon Allen continues as lead back vs NE

items.text: ETR IN list: Ladd McConkey, Quentin Johnston, DeVonta Smith, CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty, Michael Penix, Marvin Harrison Jr (vs Texans context) cleared/no designation.
items.why: Removed from reports or full participation; Schefter confirmed McConkey no designation
items.implication: Smith returns to McKee; Lamb full; McConkey back in LAC offense; Jeanty available
items.opportunity: Full route/target shares restored for clears; Smith primary in PHI pass game

items.text: ETR OUT: David Montgomery, Rashee Rice (plus Baker Mayfield, others).
items.implication: HOU RB to other backs; KC WR hierarchy without Rice (Worthy etc. elevated)
items.opportunity: xavier-worthy and KC remaining WRs; HOU RB committee

items.text: Friday addition to the Colts injury report: TE Tyler Warren (groin) questionable.
items.why: Groin suffered in Friday individual drills
items.implication: New risk for IND TE usage; monitor
items.opportunity: If limited/OUT, other IND pass-catchers (Pittman/Downs/Pierce) gain

items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) for Sunday’s game vs the Rams.
items.implication: ARI backfield thins further; check remaining RBs/usage for Trey McBride etc.
items.opportunity: Pass-game lean or other ARI RBs

items.text: Berry LOVES Mike Evans vs WSH (WR4): Commanders defense a buffet for pass catchers.
items.why: Soft WSH matchup for WRs; usage bankable
items.opportunity: High target/RZ upside vs weak secondary

items.text: Berry LOVES Drake London vs CHI (WR6), George Kittle vs WSH (TE3), Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) for usage + soft/leaking matchups; also Javonte Williams @GB (RB8 goal-line) and Rhamondre vs NYJ (RB9).
items.why: London/Golden bankable usage; Kittle/Evans vs WSH; Kyren elite recent usage + ARI run D leak; Javonte GL role; Rhamondre volume vs leaky Jets

items.text: Berry HATES Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28), Emeka Egbuka vs PIT (WR34), Kyle Pitts vs CHI (TE18); also Bo Nix vs SEA (QB23) and Justin Herbert @KC (QB25). RB hates include JK Dobbins vs SEA.
items.why: Ugly matchups (SEA pass D elite), shaky QB play/feeding, low team totals, run D shutdowns
